patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: My roommate tested positive and now I've got the sniffles. Do I need a test? A note for work? Antivirals? Should I be worried?
presentation.triageNote: 24-year-old healthy female with two days of mild upper respiratory symptoms and a positive home test, no breathlessness and a clear chest.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this healthy young adult has mild upper-respiratory symptoms, normal oxygenation, and no expected counted emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has a mild self-limited viral respiratory illness without lower-respiratory findings.
clinical.acuityReason: Normal breathing, clear lungs, and oxygen saturation 99% support home care.
keyFindings: Two days of mild upper-respiratory symptoms
teachingPoints: Worsening breathing, dehydration, chest pain, confusion, or persistent severe fever should prompt reassessment.
Home isolation and treatment guidance should reflect current public-health recommendations.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Supportive home care and return precautions would allow discharge without testing.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 24-year-old woman in a hoodie with a scarf, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting cross-legged and upright, a tissue in one hand
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a white 24-year-old woman in a hoodie with a scarf, seated on a FULL-SIZE ADULT blue padded clinic chair with a tall back and a normal adult seat height - the chair must be properly proportioned for a grown adult, clearly large enough for her, with her knees bent at a comfortable right angle and both feet resting flat on the floor. It must NOT be a small, low or child-sized chair and NOT a stool, and her knees must NOT sit higher than her hips. Pose: sitting upright and comfortable, a tissue in one hand. Expression: slightly anxious but perfectly well. Clearly visible: a faintly pink nose; no distress at all; a correctly proportioned adult-sized chair. Overall: entirely well, mildly snuffly. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
